label: Library ERD from an Indonesian requirement

request.requirement: Buatkan ERD untuk sistem manajemen perpustakaan yang memiliki anggota, buku, peminjaman, pengembalian, dan denda. Buat relasinya secara benar, tampilkan PK dan FK.
request.title: Library ERD

label: Leave approval flowchart with a rejection branch

request.requirement: Buat flowchart approval pengajuan cuti: mulai, ajukan cuti, periksa berkas, jika lengkap setujui, jika tidak tolak, selesai.
request.title: Leave Approval

label: UML class diagram with inheritance, realization, and composition

request.requirement: Class diagram: abstract class User { id: UUID; name: String; login(): Boolean } class Customer extends User { email: String } class Order { id: UUID; total: Decimal; pay(): Boolean } class OrderItem { quantity: Integer } interface Payable { pay(): Boolean } Customer ..|> Payable. Order *-- "1..*" OrderItem.
request.title: Domain Class Model

label: UML use-case diagram with two actors

request.requirement: Use case diagram perpustakaan: aktor Anggota, Pustakawan. use case Pinjam Buku, Kembalikan Buku, Kelola Buku. Anggota melakukan Pinjam Buku dan Kembalikan Buku. Pustakawan melakukan Kelola Buku. Pinjam Buku include Verifikasi Anggota.
request.title: Library Use Cases

label: UML activity diagram with decision branches

request.requirement: Activity diagram pengajuan: start -> isi formulir -> periksa berkas -> {Lengkap?}; {Lengkap?} -> ya: setujui; {Lengkap?} -> tidak: tolak; setujui -> final; tolak -> final.
request.title: Submission Activity

label: UML state machine with guards and actions

request.requirement: State machine Order: [*] -> Draft. Draft -> Submitted [submit]. Submitted -> Approved [approve] / sendEmail. Submitted -> Rejected [reject]. Approved -> [*]. Rejected -> [*].
request.title: Order State Machine

label: Sequence diagram with an alt frame

request.requirement: Arsitektur e-commerce: group Frontend: Client; group Backend: API Gateway, Order Service, Email Worker; group Data: PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ. Client memanggil API Gateway: HTTPS. Order Service membaca PostgreSQL: SQL. Order Service publishes RabbitMQ: AMQP. RabbitMQ -> Email Worker: consume.
request.title: Ecommerce Architecture
